item.speaker: Item tooltip / registry
item.meaning: Keep item identity; lore explains acquisition or use, not a different item.

quest.speaker: Quest giver / objective tracker
quest.meaning: Match the named quest, chapter, actual objectives, delivery items and unlocks.

screen.speaker: Interface
screen.display: Heading, card, button, status or tooltip
screen.meaning: Describe the current action/state; long bodies must wrap or scroll completely.

message.speaker: Server feedback / NPC dialogue
message.meaning: Preserve success/failure reason, next action, speaker and recipients.

command.speaker: Command feedback
command.meaning: Command literals remain unchanged; surrounding explanations are localized.

reward.speaker: Reward selection
reward.display: Reward card, confirmation or collection notice
reward.meaning: Distinguish earned, pending and collected rewards; preserve quantities and ownership.

text.speaker: Gameplay service
text.meaning: Preserve materials, prices, quantities and conditions; parameters carry runtime values.

reputation.speaker: Reputation service
reputation.display: Trust incident, access or reparation feedback
reputation.meaning: Keep track, change sign, prerequisites and personal/village scope.

entity.speaker: Entity registry
entity.meaning: Name the actual NPC or caravan role consistently.

hud.speaker: Route overlay
hud.meaning: Match route direction, status and controls without changing bound command names.

tag.speaker: Item tag registry
tag.meaning: Name the actual ingredient group; legacy key namespaces remain compatible.
